steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Context: Elizabeth I was born on 7 September 1533 at Greenwich Palace, the daughter of Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn. Her path to the throne was far from straightforward - she was declared illegitimate, excluded from the succession, imprisoned in the Tower of London, and survived the dangerous reigns of her half-brother Edward VI and her half-sister Mary I. These experiences shaped her into a cautious, pragmatic, and deeply intelligent ruler. | How Elizabeth's Early Life Shaped Her Rule: The execution of her mother and her own imprisonment in the Tower taught Elizabeth the dangers of political life and the importance of caution.
